issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: white_wall_banner, red_banner.

notes.artefacts: the white wall banners at (0,6,0) and (2,6,0) hang right in front of the lanterns at (0,5,1) and (2,5,1), so from the front the lanterns are hidden
notes.purpose: red standing banner on top and white banners on the crossbar make it read as a banner pole at once

visual.summary: Adds the kingdom's red banner on top of the pole and two white banners on the crossbar; now clearly a banner pole and much more striking than L1.
problems: Lanterns (0,5,1) and (2,5,1) are hidden behind the white wall banners (0,6,0), (2,6,0) from the front: widen the crossbar to 5 (lanterns at the outer ends, banners inside) or move the lanterns lower/elsewhere so they stay visible.
